description: Upload an insurance loss run (PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 25 MB) from this computer and extract its claims. This never charges anything. The extraction runs in the background and usually takes a few minutes. When it finishes it is priced from the number of claims found (1 paid credit per 5 claims, rounded up) and waits, locked, for the user to approve the cost. Returns the extraction id. Check it with get_extraction. Once it's locked, tell the user the claim count and cost, and only if they agree call unlock_result; then fetch the claims with get_claims. If a call failed or timed out, check list_extractions before uploading the same file again.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the loss run file on this computer.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the extraction to finish before returning, 0 to 50 (default 0).

name: extract_loss_run
title: Extract claims from a loss run
